title: Apache nifi: Kafka broker using SASL/OAUTHBEARER with the default validator (sasl (CVE-2026-110985)
description: A critical security vulnerability (CVE-2026-110985) exists in Apache NiFi versions prior to 2.10.0-r15. The issue involves the Kafka broker using SASL/OAUTHBEARER authentication with the default validator (sasl), which could lead to high-impact confidentiality and integrity breaches. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 9.1, indicating it is remotely exploitable without privileges or user interaction. A fix is available in version 2.10.0-r15.
